dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D narrowing observed from the mid-section toward both the visible anterior and posterior extremities of the dorsal segment.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Minimal; the lateral margins appear largely linear and smooth with negligible structural deviation where the skin meets the water.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey to off-white; high-intensity reflectance characteristic of a late-stage juvenile or sub-adult.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse grey shading visible primarily along the mid-to-posterior right lateral-dorsal margin.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse, low-gradient transition between the central lighter dorsal plane and the darker marginal shading.
